blind.description: A square ceremonial velvet cushion in deep crimson/burgundy with gold braided cord trim around the perimeter and gold tassels at each of the four corners. Resting in a central depression on top is an ornate gold crown circlet with pointed peaks. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and well-formed with realistic tufting/creasing under the crown.
blind.from_above: A square deep-red cushion with gold corner tassels and a gold-corded edge, centered with a circular golden crown showing eight outward-pointing peaks.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/7 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 9-10 inches tall); width is roughly 1.3 to 1.5 feet across.
